§3§lPreparation and use§r
Switch the Link Terminal to Energy mode and right-click a cover-compatible position on a supported GT base energy container. Energy mode shows a yellow §13 × 3§r guide grid. Binding a laser hatch consumes §11§r Laser Vacuum Pipe. Tick this quest after understanding the binding procedure.

§3§lBuffer and power delivery§r
The cover injects up to §1V × A EU§r per tick and refills from the wireless grid at each interaction interval. Capacity is V × A × (interaction ticks + redundancy ticks) EU. The defaults are §1600§r interaction ticks and §1200§r redundancy ticks, giving §1V × A × 800 EU§r. Default downlink loss is §115%§r; it and the interaction interval are configurable in config/gtswn/gtswn_network.cfg.

§3§lRemoval and remaining energy§r
When the cover is removed, its remaining buffer is credited to the wireless grid at (§11§r − uplink loss fraction). §cThe remainder returns to the grid rather than as a player item; keep the machine chunk loaded.§r
